neighbours.label: the last piece of an identifier inside a backtick code span in prose or a docstring (the closing backtick is expected next; the output direction promotes '`' and '**')
fire: To parse the response, pass the body to `json.loads` and check the result.
Each worker must override `_process_batch` before it can be registered.
When the flag is set to `DEBUG`, every request is printed to the console.
The helper returns a `pandas.DataFrame` with one row per user.
You can close the handle early by calling `release_lock()` on the session.
Errors are reported through `logging.error`, so configure a handler first.
The default value of `max_retries` is three, which suits most clients.
Wrap the iterator in `itertools.chain` if you need a single stream.
quiet: To parse the response, pass the body to the JSON loader and check the result.
Each worker must override the batch processing method before it can be registered.
When the flag is set to debug mode, every request is printed to the console.
The helper returns a pandas data frame with one row per user.
You can close the handle early by calling release_lock on the session object.
Errors are reported through the logging module, so configure a handler first.
The default value of max_retries is three, which suits most clients.
Wrap the iterator in a chain from itertools if you need a single stream.

notes: Probes: backticked identifiers 0.56-0.75, the same identifier without backticks 0.005, a word in curly quotes 0.13.
